meta.read_rule: Use Qoovex-Brain as canonical operational memory and repository code as truth for implemented state.

project.name: Qoovex
project.audience: small construction businesses, subcontractors, craftspeople and safety consultants
project.positioning: An exception-driven operating system for documents, deadlines and construction-site evidence.
project.promise: Qoovex executes deterministic and reversible operational work and presents exceptions, decisions and results for review.
project.legal_limit: Qoovex does not guarantee compliance, certify people or documents, or replace professional, technical, medical or legal judgment.

verified_current_state.summary: The authenticated Workspace contains a persistent operational engine and a reduced operational-center experience over the existing domain.
active_domain: document types, requirements, documents and private versions
document packages and controlled share links
product audit, support and data control

operational_engine.runtime: Server-side versioned registry, centralized lifecycle, atomic claim, five-minute lease, fencing, at most five attempts and 1/5/15/60-minute backoff.
operational_engine.entrypoint: Authenticated Workspace only; the universal intake composes existing authorized flows and is not a generic mutation endpoint.

verified_current_state.security: Authorization, organizationId and resource scope are server-derived and default-deny. Prisma stores data and metadata; private Vercel Blob stores binaries. Operational artifacts never persist file content, Blob keys or signed URLs.
verified_current_state.migration_history: The repository contains ten canonical migration directories through 20260726010000_operational_engine_phase_3. The tenth migration was applied and verified only on the guarded local database; every remote environment requires separate verification and authorization.
verified_current_state.workspace: The compatible /dashboard route presents Centro operativo. Primary navigation is Centro operativo, Documenti, Lavoratori, Cantieri, authorized Pacchetti and Impostazioni; notifications and account remain in the topbar. /operations/[processId] presents the authorized process detail.
verified_current_state.design_system: Unchanged in Phase 3: shadcn base-nova, Base UI, Geist/Geist Mono, Tabler and light/dark/system theme. packages/ui and apps/sirio are untouched.

product: Qoovex is exception-driven while the existing domain remains rich.
Processes are first-class and existing records remain sources and outputs.
Exceptions and decisions are the primary human work.
Manual correction and advanced domain control remain available.
External sharing remains explicit and uses existing controlled flows.
Success is measured through manual work avoided.

execution_policy.automatic: Only LOW-impact, deterministic, reversible and authorized actions with VERIFIED or HIGH reliability.
execution_policy.decision_required: CONTROLLED impact or MEDIUM, LOW or CONFLICT reliability.
execution_policy.forbidden: SENSITIVE or IRREVERSIBLE actions, access expansion, disclosure and legal operations unless an explicit existing authorized flow handles them.

process_guarantees: append-only operational events with allow-listed payloads
operational timeline remains distinct from technical audit
implemented_decisions.authorization: No new role or permission. Reading requires organization:read plus artifact scope; decisions, resolution and retry require the existing permission for the underlying effect.
implemented_decisions.runner: GitHub Actions reuses CRON_SECRET and invokes the runner every five minutes; no queue or external dependency was added.
implemented_decisions.lifecycle: Cancellation and undo are not exposed while their policy remains open. Technical exhaustion opens an exception; business uncertainty does not retry indefinitely.
implemented_decisions.rules: Each run captures a minimized immutable snapshot of the DocumentRequirement inputs used. Later rule changes affect only new runs.

items: OCR or AI extraction, classification or matching
SLA, monitoring commitments or commercial entitlements
conceptual_not_implemented.warning: These items are future directions only and do not authorize providers, schema, jobs, disclosure, retention, UI or legal claims.

open_hard_stops: OCR or AI provider, evaluation policy and sensitive-document treatment
undo window, cancellation and compensation policy
export formats beyond existing controlled exports
recommended_future_sequence: verify local Phase 3 behavior and database impact
obtain explicit authorization before any remote migration or deploy
measure manual work avoided and exception closure quality
decide undo, retention and monitoring policies
evaluate search or fallible extraction only behind approved adapters and evidence gates

technical_state.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 uses CSS-first configuration in the Next.js apps.
technical_state.typography: Sirio, Web and Workspace load Geist and Geist Mono through next/font; @qoovex/brand-resources is asset-only.
technical_state.design_system: @qoovex/ui is the unchanged shared shadcn base-nova foundation with Base UI, Tabler and the Vercel light/dark/system theme; domain compositions remain app-local.
technical_state.workspace_architecture: FSD placement: shared server infrastructure, operational feature services/actions, entity read widgets, view compositions and app routing.
technical_state.database_environments: Production, Preview, local development and CI use distinct guarded targets. Phase 3 was migrated only on local; remote state is not claimed.
technical_state.database_operations: Every database-sensitive task applies docs/OperationalProtocol.md#database-operation-impact and preserves correctness, authorization and tenant isolation.
